title: Zero-shot TSFMs against the Khepri v1.5 baselines, 96-hour carbon intensity, nine Nordic zones: a preregistered comparison (arXiv record)
note: v1, one author, physics.soc-ph and cs.LG, CC BY 4.0, 15 pages. Timestral-5M, Timestral-209M and Chronos-2, zero-shot, against unchanged Khepri v1.5 SARIMA and GBM; 96 h hourly carbon intensity, zones NO1-NO5 and SE1-SE4. Design, analysis code and minimum detectable effect timestamped (OpenTimestamps, GPG-signed tag) before any foundation-model forecast. Links Zenodo record and OSF osf.io/hncz5.

title: Zero-shot TSFMs against the Khepri v1.5 baselines, 96-hour carbon intensity, nine Nordic zones: a preregistered comparison (arXiv record)
note: Abstract results: 2025 test, 361 daily origins, all three models 0.952 to 1.347 points lower zone-averaged MAPE than both baselines, ahead of SARIMA in 9 of 9 zones. Holdout, 14 origins from 2026-10-16: 0.729 to 1.326 points lower, inside the preregistered MDE of 2.989, reported as not determined. Holdout CRPS below SARIMA for all three; SARIMA quantiles are Gaussian, not native.

title: Zero-shot TSFMs against the Khepri v1.5 baselines: a preregistered comparison (full text)
note: Setup: ENTSO-E generation per type turned into hourly gCO2-eq/kWh by Khepri v1.5. Daily 00:00 UTC origins, hours 1 to 96. Retro test 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (361 origins per zone), baselines trained to 2023-12-31. Holdout origins 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-29. All arms univariate, context 8192 h. Baselines fitted once: SARIMAX (2,0,1)(1,1,0,24); LightGBM, 3 seeds.

title: Zero-shot TSFMs against the Khepri v1.5 baselines: a preregistered comparison (full text)
note: Retro 2025 zone-averaged 96 h MAPE: SARIMA 7.561, GBM 7.347, Timestral-5M 6.253, Timestral-209M 6.213, Chronos-2 6.395. Differences vs SARIMA -1.308, -1.347, -1.166 points; vs GBM -1.094, -1.134, -0.952. HLN Diebold-Mariano p below 0.0001 after Holm. Retro MDE 0.413 points. No standard errors or intervals for these in the tables as read.

title: Zero-shot TSFMs against the Khepri v1.5 baselines: a preregistered comparison (full text)
note: Holdout MAPE (14 origins): SARIMA 9.332, GBM 9.223, Timestral-5M 8.415, Timestral-209M 8.005, Chronos-2 8.494. Differences vs SARIMA -0.917, -1.326, -0.838; vs GBM -0.808, -1.218, -0.729; all inside MDE 2.989. NO5 is constant in the holdout and carries no ranking information. Holdout CRPS: SARIMA 1.4165, T-5M 1.1114, T-209M 1.0733, Chronos-2 1.1198.
